title: Ancillary and Optional Services Billing: Charges for Non-Covered Supplies and Oxygen Concentrators
content:
Section 1. Non-routine medical supplies that no payer of the resident covers are charged under Ancillary and Optional Services Billing at the center's acquisition cost plus the tier's markup; for every payer that covers supplies the markup is zero because nothing is charged.

Section 2. An oxygen concentrator the resident's payer does not cover is charged monthly at the tier's oxygen concentrator charge.

## The two rates by tier

| Ancillary account tier | Markup on acquisition cost | Oxygen concentrator charge, per month |
|---|---|---|
| Ancillary Account, Medicare Part A Consolidated Billing | 0 percent | USD 0.00 |
| Ancillary Account, Medicare Part B | 0 percent | USD 185.00 |
| Ancillary Account, Medical Assistance | 0 percent | USD 0.00 |
| Ancillary Account, Private Pay | 25 percent | USD 185.00 |
| Ancillary Account, Medicare Advantage | 0 percent | USD 0.00 |
| Ancillary Account, Hospice Election | 0 percent | USD 0.00 |

## Worked supply charge (hypothetical cost)

A non-routine medical supply covered by no payer of a resident in Ancillary Account, Private Pay, with an acquisition cost of USD 37.84: the markup is 25 percent of USD 37.84, that is USD 9.46, and the charge is USD 37.84 plus USD 9.46, that is USD 47.30.

## Points of judgement

- **The resident's payer covers supplies.** Nothing is charged for them, which is why the markup is zero.
- **A non-covered oxygen concentrator in Ancillary Account, Medicare Part B.** Charged monthly at USD 185.00.
